mapper.sql: RECOMMENDATIONID, RECOMMENDATIONNO, RECOMMENDATIONNAME, RECOMMENDATIONTYPE, MODELID, ANALYSISID, RECOMMENDATIONCONTENT, EXPECTEDBENEFIT, RISKASSESSMENT, IMPLEMENTATIONPLAN, PRIORITY, CONFIDENCELEVEL, RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS, REVIEWUSER, REVIEWDATE, REVIEWOPINION, IMPLEMENTATIONDATE, IMPLEMENTATIONRESULT, REMARK, ORGID, CREATETIME, CREATEUSER, UPDATETIME, UPDATEUSER
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE RECOMMENDATIONTYPE = #{recommendationType} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS = #{recommendationStatus} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE PRIORITY = #{priority} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE MODELID = #{modelId} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE ANALYSISID = #{analysisId} AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS = 'PENDING' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY PRIORITY DESC, CREATETIME ASC
SELECT FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS = 'REVIEWED' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY REVIEWDATE DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS = 'APPROVED' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY REVIEWDATE DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS = 'REJECTED' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY REVIEWDATE DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS = 'IMPLEMENTED' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY IMPLEMENTATIONDATE DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE PRIORITY = 'HIGH' AND ORGID = #{orgId} ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND CREATETIME >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '#{days}' DAY ORDER BY CREATETIME DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS SET REVIEWUSER = #{reviewUser}, REVIEWDATE = CURRENT_DATE, REVIEWOPINION = #{reviewOpinion}, UPDATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDATEUSER = #{updateUser} WHERE RECOMMENDATIONID = #{recommendationId}
mapper.select: SELECT RECOMMENDATIONTYPE AS recommendationType, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}), 2) AS percentage, AVG(CONFIDENCELEVEL) AS avgConfidence FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY RECOMMENDATIONTYPE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS AS recommendationStatus, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}), 2) AS percentage FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT PRIORITY AS priority, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}), 2) AS percentage, AVG(CONFIDENCELEVEL) AS avgConfidence FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} GROUP BY PRIORITY ORDER BY CASE PRIORITY WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

SELECT CASE WHEN CONFIDENCELEVEL >= 90 THEN 'VERY_HIGH' WHEN CONFIDENCELEVEL >= 80 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN CONFIDENCELEVEL >= 70 THEN 'MEDIUM' WHEN CONFIDENCELEVEL >= 60 THEN 'LOW' ELSE 'VERY_LOW' END AS confidenceLevel, COUNT(*) AS count, AVG(CONFIDENCELEVEL) AS avgConfidence, MIN(CONFIDENCELEVEL) AS minConfidence, MAX(CONFIDENCELEVEL) AS maxConfidence FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND CONFIDENCELEVEL IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE WHEN CONFIDENCELEVEL >= 90 THEN 'VERY_HIGH' WHEN CONFIDENCELEVEL >= 80 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN CONFIDENCELEVEL >= 70 THEN 'MEDIUM' WHEN CONFIDENCELEVEL >= 60 THEN 'LOW' ELSE 'VERY_LOW' END ORDER BY avgConfidence DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalRecommendations, AVG(CONFIDENCELEVEL) AS avgConfidence, COUNT(CASE WHEN CONFIDENCELEVEL >= 90 THEN 1 END) AS veryHighConfidenceCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN CONFIDENCELEVEL >= 80 AND CONFIDENCELEVEL < 90 THEN 1 END) AS highConfidenceCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN CONFIDENCELEVEL < 80 THEN 1 END) AS lowConfidenceCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) AS approvedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS = 'IMPLEMENTED' THEN 1 END) AS implementedCount FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE MODELID = #{modelId} AND ORGID = #{orgId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalRecommendations, COUNT(CASE WHEN RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS = 'IMPLEMENTED' THEN 1 END) AS implementedRecommendations, COUNT(CASE WHEN RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) AS approvedRecommendations, COUNT(CASE WHEN RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END) AS rejectedRecommendations, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS = 'IMPLEMENTED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS implementationRate, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS approvalRate, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS rejectionRate FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND CREATETIME < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '#{retentionDays}' DAY AND RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS IN ('IMPLEMENTED', 'REJECTED')
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS SET RECOMMENDATIONCONTENT = NULL, EXPECTEDBENEFIT = NULL, RISKASSESSMENT = NULL WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND CREATETIME < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90' DAY
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND ( (CONFIDENCELEVEL IS NOT NULL AND CONFIDENCELEVEL < 0) OR (CONFIDENCELEVEL IS NOT NULL AND CONFIDENCELEVEL > 100) OR (RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS = 'REVIEWED' AND REVIEWUSER IS NULL) OR (RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS = 'IMPLEMENTED' AND IMPLEMENTATIONDATE IS NULL) ) ORDER BY UPDATETIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS = 'PENDING' AND CREATETIME < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7' DAY ORDER BY CREATETIME ASC
SELECT FROM TBL_DECISION_RECOMMENDATIONS WHERE ORGID = #{orgId} AND RECOMMENDATIONSTATUS = 'APPROVED' AND REVIEWDATE < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '#{days}' DAY ORDER BY REVIEWDATE ASC
